Local async build was started via the project's built-in kickoff script, the job was polled

```
node scripts/start-async-build.mjs
```

```json
{"jobId":"job-1791096476096-45072","status":"building"}
```

- `.fixture/async-current.json` -> `{ "jobId": "job-1791096476096-45072" }`

```
node scripts/show-async-status.mjs
```

```
{"jobId":"job-1791096476096-45072","status":"ready","artifact":"dist/async-build.txt"}
```

```json
{
  "jobId": "job-1791096476096-45072",
  "status": "ready",
  "artifact": "dist/async-build.txt"
}
```

Command:

```
node scripts/verify-async-build.mjs
```

```
async build verifier: PASS job-1791096476096-45072
```

- Path: `dist/async-build.txt` (relative to project workspace; absolute:

- Content:

```
release-ready
```

Directory listing (`ls -l dist`):

```
-rw-r--r--  1 apple  staff  14 Oct  4 14:47 async-build.txt
```

- [x] Located and started the built-in local async build kickoff command, obtained job id
